newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-NO PLAY ON OUTSIDE COURTS FOR SECOND DAY RUNNING.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NO PLAY ON OUTSIDE COURTS FOR SECOND DAY RUNNING.

text.p: Play on Wimbledon's outside courts was abandoned on Friday for the second day running without a ball being struck.
Organisers said just after 1700 GMT that although the rain, which had been falling all day, had stopped the surface of the courts was too greasy to be safe to play.
It was still very overcast and organisers said they would defer a decision about play on Centre Court and Number One court.
